name: mailnext.draft-fixture-metadata
description: Read bounded metadata for a known fixture draft by its native draft ID, including complete subject up to 512 characters and complete body HTML up to 16 KiB, plus attachment names, sizes, and types; never returns partial subject/body snapshots, sender fields, recipients, or tokens.

parameters.name: draftId
parameters.description: Native draft ID returned by MAIL_CREATE_DRAFT.

evidence.snippet: lS maps draft id, threadId, replyMessageId, attachments, and images
